identity.description: An attacker creates a new process under an untrusted causality actor and initiates a network connection to a C2 server. Cortex detects this behavior as an anomalous network connection under an unusual process context.

expected_artifacts.description: Newly created process under untrusted actor

biocs.name: Uncommon Network Connection Under Untrusted Actor
biocs.description: Detects network activity originating from a newly created process under an untrusted causality actor
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = '/tmp/.system/evil'
| filter action_remote_ip != '127.0.0.1'
| filter action_remote_ip != '0.0.0.0'
| filter action_remote_ip != '::'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.0/24'
| filter action_remote_ip != '10.0.0.0/8'
| filter action_remote_ip != '172.16.0.0/12'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.168.0.0/16'

abiocs.name: Newly Created Process Initiating Outbound Network Connection

xql_queries.name: Hunt for Uncommon Network Connections Under New Actors
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name like '/tmp/.system/%'
| filter action_remote_ip != '127.0.0.1'
| filter action_remote_ip != '0.0.0.0'
| filter action_remote_ip != '::'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.0/24'
| filter action_remote_ip != '10.0.0.0/8'
| filter action_remote_ip != '172.16.0.0/12'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.168.0.0/16'
| comp count() by action_remote_ip, causality_actor_process_image_name
